PSG Coach Hopes Man City Avoid Title Stripping Over Financial Rules

Paris Saint-Germain coach Luis Enrique expressed hope that Manchester City will not be stripped of their titles despite a ruling on financial breaches. Enrique stated that Manchester City deserved their trophies, even with the financial breach. The comments were made ahead of a Champions League clash.
